blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Team Philippines assured itself a breakthrough medal finish in soft tennis a day before the formal opening of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026. Princess Catindig, Bien Zoleta, Christy Sanosa, Shyryn Salazar and Hilary Paas secured a top two finish in Group B of the women’s team event to give the Philippines a spot in the semifinals. During group play held at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center, the Philippines beat Mongolia, 3-0, and Thailand, 2-1, before falling to Chinese-Taipei, 3-0.
